speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: All right, Raj has played his phantom warlord card, and I am going to back him up with my strangling vines. Choke on that, sucka.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Okay, well, then I'll just cut your vines with my ruby sword. That's right, I did it. I cut'em.

speaker: penny
text: Um, I have a question.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Warlord beats troll, troll beats elf, elf beats water sprite, and basically everything beats enchanted bunny.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Unless you have the carrot power.

speaker: penny
text: Okay, I've got another question. When does this get fun?

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Are we going to talk or are we going to play Mystic Warlords of Ka-ah?

text: Just play a potion card.

text: Sheldon, don't ruin the game.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Given the cards that have already been played, Penny can only be holding necromancer potions, which are only effective against wraiths and day-walkers, and there are no more of either left to be drawn. The cards remaining in the undrawn stack are four fire weapons, a troll, two ogres and the jewel of Osiris.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: See? Ruined.

speaker: penny
text: Sheldon, that is incredible.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: From your vantage point, it certainly must seem so.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Sheldon has kind of a photographic memory.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Photographic is a misnomer. I have an eidetic memory, as I've told you many times. Most recently last year during lunch on the afternoon of may seventh. You had turkey and complained it was dry.

text: Well, I guess game's over.

text: Really? Oh, great. I mean, aw. Okay, I gotta go.

text: Why?

speaker: penny
text: Because the last me I didn't go, I ended up playing Mystic Warlords of Ka.

text: See ya. Still can't believe she's going out with me.

text: Nobody can.

text: That reminds me, I have a bone to pick with you. You and I made a pact that if either of us ever got a hot girlfriend, that person would have his girlfriend hook the other guy up with one of her girlfriends.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: What?

text: Yeah, I don't remember that.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: June 30th, 2004. Opening day of Spider-man 2 at the AMC Pasadena. They only had red icees, no blue.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Oh, yeah.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: So you've been with Penny for like a month and a half now. Where's my shorty, Morty?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Howard, you can't hold me to that. Because when I made that agreement, I didn't think I'd ever have a hot girlfriend. And I was positive you never would.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Why not?

text: Hey, how come I wasn't part of this deal?

text: You had left the refreshment stand in order to indulge in your customary preemptive pre-show urination.

text: Oh, so that's how it works? I have a teeny bladder and now I don't get a hot girlfriend?
